kurzbeschreibung: Landeck and the Paznaun Valley – where the mountains stretch wider and the Oberinntal opens up into a grand alpine world.
beschreibung: The district of Landeck covers the Upper Inn Valley around the district town of Landeck, as well as the deeply carved Paznauntal valley. Landeck itself is a historic trading town with the landmark Schloss Landeck, dating back to the 13th century. The Paznauntal is one of Tirol’s most important tourism regions, home to the world-famous ski resorts Ischgl and See. Serfaus and Fiss together with Ladis form the luxurious ski area Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis, featuring top-modern facilities and excellent gastronomy. Nauders is located on the sunny high plateau at the border with Italy and Switzerland and is Tirol’s southernmost town with over 300 sunny days a year.
tipps: The cable cars in Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis rank among the finest in the Alps – the Serfaus underground village metro is unique.
Landeck Castle houses the regional district heritage museum along with an impressive historic arms collection.
The Nauders high-altitude panoramic trail offers a rewarding family hike overlooking the border triangle.
empfehlungen: Explore the old town of Landeck with its Schloss Landeck and enjoy the view over the Inntal valley. Then head to the Paznauntal in Ischgl for excellent cuisine and Après-Ski.
umgebung: The Landeck region borders the Lechtaler Alpen to the north, Südtirol (Italy) to the south across the main Alpine ridge, and the Arlberg region to the west. Neighboring regions include: Arlberg (west), Imst (east), Kaunertal (south), and Paznauntal (southwest). The Reschenpass leads to Italy.
